senses.gloss: (b. h. in בֹּהַק; √בה , v. בהי) to shine with a pale light, be white, glisten.
units: Bekh. 45ᵇ בּוֹהֵק one glistening (with unsteady eyes, albino), diff. fr. לבן white-complected.

senses.gloss: to shine, be bright. Y. Pes. I, beg. 27ᵇ top בשעה שהיו מבהיקים when the candles burned brightly.
units: <cite ref="Yoma 2a">Ib.</cite> <he>מַבְהִיקוֹת</he>; <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 31:11">Gen. R. s. 31</cite> <he>מַבְהֶקֶת</he> (of glistening jewels).
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 40:5">Gen. R. s. 40</cite> <he>הבהיקה כל וכ׳</he> the whole land of Egypt was brightened by her (Sarah’s) beauty; a. fr.
<cite ref="Kiddushin 33a:13">Kidd. 33ᵃ</cite> <he>ברבו המ׳</he> when his teacher is a distinguished scholar.

<cite ref="Gittin 11a:2">Gitt. 11ᵃ</cite> <he>שמות מוּבְהָקִין</he> names of a distinctly gentile character (which Jews do not assume). [Sifra Thazr. ch. I <he>שאת מובהקת</he>, read with R. S. to <cite ref="Mishnah Negaim 1:1">Neg. I, 1</cite> <he>מוגבהת</he>, v. <cite ref="C00049"><he>גָּבַהּ</he></cite>.]
